scope.objective: Reach the frozen preferred CVPR scale of at least 60 H2_HUMAN_ADJUDICATED_SATURATION_AUDITED families from at least 30 source groups with at least 12 prospectively untouched test groups.

authoritative_inputs.role: Frozen paper position, preferred and fallback scale, source policy, and claim firewall
Machine-readable frozen Pivot-v2 targets and six-role construct policy
Current development-only coverage, shortages, and non-forcing rules
Ranked source routes, grouping rules, duration/audio rules, and narrowing triggers
Audio-rich V+S+A route ranking and technical/governance preflights
Exact acquired P27_101 and P28_103 inventory
Exact acquired P23_102 inventory and use boundary
P23_102 development-only classification and diagnostic execution boundary
Exact EPIC reserve participant pool and Assembly101 participant inventory
Independent-lineage access status and fail-closed selection rule

grouping_and_split_firewall.atomic_source_group: The complete continuous source or coherent session plus every clip, alternate encode, synchronized view, transcript, annotation, frame, audio stem, feature, benchmark derivative, and future derivative.
grouping_and_split_firewall.participant_block: All repeated recordings for one participant, wearer, household, kitchen, team, or controlled-capture identity remain in one split. CaptainCook4D person-level supergroups and Assembly101 participant blocks are mandatory.
grouping_and_split_firewall.production_lineage_block: Mirrors, excerpts, alternate edits, embedded clips, documentary episodes sharing archive components, and correlated production families remain together. NASA/JPL documentary alternatives cannot be counted as independent lineages; EPIC and HD-EPIC cannot receive independent-lineage credit; Ego4D and Ego-Exo4D cannot receive independent-lineage credit.
grouping_and_split_firewall.dataset_lineage_stratum: Participant-disjoint groups from one dataset may occupy different splits only when participant, household, scene, kitchen, continuous-recording, and derivative overlap checks pass. They count as one dataset/production stratum for diversity reporting, never as independent publisher lineages.
forbidden_split_moves: No source, participant block, or production-lineage block may move after any semantic exposure.
No source may move because candidate yield, profile, difficulty, model behavior, or H2 outcome is disappointing.
A failed group may be replaced only by the next predeclared same-split reserve before that reserve has semantic exposure.
Every replacement requires a dated addendum, old and new IDs, reason code, exposure ledger snapshot, and recomputed split hash.

untouched_test_policy.reservation_time: Before acquisition-driven semantic review, candidate mining, question authoring, or model inspection
allowed_before_test_unlock: Identity, route, hash, duration, container, stream, synchronization, rights, privacy, lineage, and malware checks
Deduplication and participant/production overlap checks that do not inspect semantic labels or content
Custody, retention, withdrawal, and deletion preparation
forbidden_before_test_unlock: Listening or viewing for candidate discovery
Opening transcripts, narrations, action labels, sound labels, mistake labels, QA, captions, or semantic timestamps
ASR, OCR, AST, CLAP, CLIP, embedding search, LLM summarization, VLM inspection, or any model-guided candidate mining
Question, answer, claim, evidence, shortcut, modality, hop, or near/far authoring
Using model outputs, retrieval scores, or pilot shortages to select among test groups
unlock_requires: Train-development and dev-calibration protocol is frozen.
Reviewer training and excluded calibration are complete.
All 12 test groups have passed acquisition, rights, lineage, duration, native-audio, privacy, and custody gates.
Test-only reviewer roster and six-role assignment graph are frozen.
Pre-unlock exposure ledger has no semantic or model exposure.
No test model runs occur until all test H2 records and intervention manifests are frozen.
untouched_test_policy.test_authoring_mode: Fresh human-only source-uniform authoring by a test-only team after unlock; no model-guided authoring or candidate mining at any time.

preferred_authoring_design.failed_target_policy: Repair, replace, accept the actual supported profile under a prospectively narrowed claim, or reject. Never force V+S+A, A, far, or any other label to preserve a quota.

train_development.reason: P23_102 is frozen development-only by its diagnostic registry

epic_participants.available_pool_fact: The frozen metadata pool contains 15 eligible extension participants and 12 named candidate/replacement rows; exact media is already present for P27, P28, and P23.
strengths: Exact IDs and durations are frozen.
P23_102 exact acquisition proves the route and native synchronized AAC for one reserve participant.
blocking_gates: Per-asset media terms and restricted annotation authority
Semantic labels, narrations, and EPIC-SOUNDS timestamps remain sealed

captaincook4d_participant_groups.available_pool_fact: The inventory has 34 eligible participant-environment groups across eight people; persons 1-3 are development, person 5 is calibration, persons 4, 6, and 7 are test, and person 8 is the untouched replacement block.
strengths: Exact person-environment inventory and person-level supergroups exist.
Three exact wave-0 recordings prove route and native audio for the dataset.
25_109 has exact route and container evidence.
blocking_gates: Governance authority for new exact acquisition
Participant consent/retention and restricted annotation authority
No recipe, action, or error label may drive selection

assembly101_participant_groups.available_pool_fact: Pinned authenticated metadata contains 48 participant lineages, 362 sessions, and 354 complete 12-view sessions; the first eight deterministic participants and next two replacements were frozen without semantic labels.
strengths: Pinned revision, exact paths, sizes, and LFS hashes.
blocking_gates: Wall-clock duration and native synchronized audio are unresolved.
Processing, restricted annotation, privacy, and custody authority are absent.
Action, mistake, object, and alternate-view semantic labels remain sealed

same_split_replacements.replacement_scope: NASA/JPL test slot only because it is correlated with the NASA/JPL documentary lineage
Independent lineage only after exact official release, IDs, duration, native audio, and rights are frozen

blocking_gates: No candidate is currently rights-ready for acquisition, processing, and restricted annotation.
Exact first-party object and item/component rights are missing for the public-event routes.
At least three independent public or licensed production lineages must survive without counting correlated alternatives separately.

requirements: Pinned release or dated first-party item identity
Exact object, HLS asset, or coherent session IDs
Expected bytes and provider hash or immutable revision-bound identity
Atomic restricted custody with source manifest and transfer log
No mirror, clip, alternate encode, or synchronized view counted as a new source group
Affirmative acquisition authority
Affirmative internal processing authority
Affirmative restricted human annotation authority
Artifact-specific release remains a separate decision
Participant consent, withdrawal, retention, deletion, takedown, attribution, and least-privilege controls
Component ledger for archive footage, music, marks, faces, voices, partner media, and embedded clips

duration.counting_rule: Count coherent wall-clock duration once; never sum synchronized camera-view hours.
duration.failure_policy: Reject or prospectively replace before semantic review. No concatenation of unrelated takes to meet duration.

requirements: At least one decodable video stream
At least one native synchronized audio stream
Audio codec, channels, sample rate, and nonempty decoded samples recorded
Beginning, middle, and end A/V timestamp delta no greater than 0.25 seconds
Audio/video stream-duration delta no greater than 0.25 seconds
Stable source-time mapping and no truncation

human_semantic_eligibility.timing: Train/dev after split freeze; test only after test unlock
requirements: Human source-uniform dynamic non-text visual prescreen where V is targeted
Human source-uniform non-speech audio prescreen where A is targeted
Substantive speech prescreen where S is targeted
Full-source recurrence and shortcut challenge
Far candidates are multi-hop coherent compositions, not distance-only pairs

A concrete localizable source-world non-speech event is necessary for A; music, score, applause, generic room noise, generic handling noise, classifier labels, and visible/spoken duplicates do not qualify

source_level_blindness: A prescreener may not later be blind finder or saturation auditor for the same source group.
A blind finder or saturation auditor may hold that blind role for at most one family from a source group.
An adjudicator may not have authored any family in the same source group.
Once a person has nonblind semantic exposure to a source, that person may not take a later blind role on that source.
Assignments and exposure snapshot are frozen before packet distribution; mutation invalidates affected packets.
h2_acceptance_requires: Substantive question, atomic claims, answer, source-time evidence, and route inventory
Two independent validators pass answerability, sufficiency, minimality, necessity, and shortcut checks
Blind full-source alternative search is complete under the frozen protocol
Blind post-adjudication saturation audit finds no unhandled answer-complete route
Intervention-v2 state surface, route closure, restoration feasibility, and metadata-leakage prerequisites pass
The record uses H2_HUMAN_ADJUDICATED_SATURATION_AUDITED and never claims gold or exhaustive evidence

automatic_invalidation: Any pre-unlock semantic or model exposure on a test source invalidates that source as untouched.
Any model-guided test authoring or candidate mining invalidates the affected test source and all derived families.
Any cross-split participant, continuous-recording, mirror, embedded-clip, or production-component overlap invalidates the affected split assignment.
Any hidden use of existing semantic labels during selection or initial authoring invalidates the source.

prospective_narrowing_triggers.observation_point: After all train-development and dev-calibration source prescreens, before test authoring
prospective_narrowing_triggers.trigger: Fewer than four development/calibration source groups yield a defensible V+S+A candidate, or fewer than two production-lineage-disjoint test groups remain technically and legally eligible for V+S+A prospecting.
prospective_narrowing_triggers.required_action: Freeze an addendum reducing or removing V+S+A targets and naming replacement profiles before test packets are authored.
prospective_narrowing_triggers.prohibited_action: Do not force A from score, surf, applause, generic handling sound, classifier labels, or co-occurrence.

prospective_narrowing_triggers.observation_point: After 54 train/dev candidate families are adjudicated
prospective_narrowing_triggers.trigger: Fewer than 18 coherent far/multi candidates or fewer than 12 far/multi H2 families survive in train plus dev.
prospective_narrowing_triggers.required_action: Prospectively narrow the far-stratum claim and revise test targets before test authoring.
prospective_narrowing_triggers.prohibited_action: Do not count one-hop distance-only or unrelated interval pairs as far.

prospective_narrowing_triggers.observation_point: After train-development and dev-calibration are complete
prospective_narrowing_triggers.trigger: Fewer than 36 H2 families survive from the planned 54 train/dev candidates, or fewer than 15 of 18 train/dev source groups contribute at least one H2.
prospective_narrowing_triggers.required_action: REPAIR authoring protocol, add predeclared development reserves, and rerun excluded calibration before unlocking test.
prospective_narrowing_triggers.prohibited_action: Do not mine the untouched test pool to compensate.

prospective_narrowing_triggers.trigger: Fewer than 12 untouched groups pass all admission gates, fewer than four capture-format categories remain, or independent-lineage slots collapse into correlated alternatives.
prospective_narrowing_triggers.required_action: Keep test locked and substitute only the next predeclared untouched same-split reserve; otherwise choose REPAIR or the frozen descriptive fallback.
prospective_narrowing_triggers.prohibited_action: Do not move semantically reviewed train/dev groups into test.

prospective_narrowing_triggers.observation_point: After test H2 freeze and before model execution
prospective_narrowing_triggers.trigger: Any proposed modality, mechanism, domain, or capture-format claim has fewer than five untouched test source groups.
prospective_narrowing_triggers.required_action: Delete or narrow that claim prospectively; retain only source-bounded descriptive reporting.
prospective_narrowing_triggers.prohibited_action: Do not pool mechanisms or correlated production lineages to reach five.

wave_sequence.name: SPLIT_AND_LEDGER_FREEZE
wave_sequence.entry: This plan is accepted as prospective governance.
work: Freeze all 30 primary groups, participant blocks, production-lineage IDs, split labels, and reserve order.
Create zero-semantic exposure snapshots for all test and test-reserve groups.
Assign restricted custody namespaces by split.
wave_sequence.exit: Split hash, reserve hash, and contamination ledger schema are signed; no semantic review has begun on test.

wave_sequence.name: RIGHTS_AND_TECHNICAL_ADMISSION
work: Close acquisition, processing, annotation, privacy, component, duration, stream, synchronization, and custody gates.
Reuse the 15 exact local development/calibration groups without redownload.
Acquire only exact allowlisted objects for unresolved train/dev/test slots.
Keep every test semantic surface sealed.
wave_sequence.exit: All 30 primary groups pass or are replaced by untouched predeclared reserves; otherwise REPAIR.

wave_sequence.name: TRAIN_DEVELOPMENT_AUTHORING
work: Human-prescreen and author exactly 36 candidate families, three per source.
Run six-role review and intervention feasibility.
Target 24 H2 without forcing profile or far labels.
wave_sequence.exit: Train H2 and labor/yield report frozen; protocol defects repaired.

wave_sequence.name: DEV_CALIBRATION_AND_PROTOCOL_LOCK
work: Author exactly 18 candidates, three per dev-calibration source.
Complete six-role review and target 12 H2.
Complete the frozen excluded calibration requirement and reviewer retraining.
Freeze authoring manual, decision rules, intervention-v2 contract, packet schema, and reviewer assignment solver.
wave_sequence.exit: At least 36 train/dev H2 from at least 15 source groups; narrowing triggers resolved; test remains untouched.

wave_sequence.name: TEST_UNLOCK_AND_HUMAN_ONLY_AUTHORING
work: Release raw A/V only to the 12-person test-only roster.
Author exactly 36 candidates, three per test source, without models or semantic labels.
Execute all six human roles and target 24 test H2.
Freeze source-time evidence, accepted SESs under the saturation protocol, state surfaces, and packet hashes.
wave_sequence.exit: At least 24 test H2 across all 12 untouched test groups, or invoke fallback/REPAIR.

wave_sequence.name: PAPER_SCALE_GATE
wave_sequence.entry: All human records and contamination audits are frozen.
work: Check preferred 60/30/12 scale, per-claim five-test-source rule, capture diversity, presentation cap, and maximum three H2 per source.
Classify preferred GO, descriptive fallback, REPAIR, or NO_GO.
No model execution occurs before this gate.
wave_sequence.exit: Preferred GO is required for causal/model claims; fallback permits descriptive diagnostics only.

wave_sequence.name: MODEL_EXECUTION_AFTER_H2_FREEZE
wave_sequence.entry: Preferred GO plus all separate baseline, runtime, leakage, intervention, and ITT gates.
work: Run frozen systems and arms with mechanism-specific R-N estimands.
Aggregate family within source then equal source.
Retain invalid and early-terminal assignments under the frozen ITT policy.
wave_sequence.exit: Audited result tables; no authority is created by this planning artifact.

budget_estimate.planning_basis: Pre-commit cap estimate; actual active and elapsed minutes must be logged by role.
budget_estimate.fallback_budget_rule: Do not buy claim language with reduced review. If the cap cannot fund preferred scale, use the descriptive fallback or stop.

all_required: At least 12 contributing untouched test source groups
At least 24 train H2, 12 dev H2, and 24 test H2
No source contributes more than three H2
Lecture/webinar/presentation-wrapped sources are no more than 25 percent
Every paper-facing modality, mechanism, domain, or capture-format claim has at least five untouched test source groups
All rights, privacy, lineage, six-role, contamination, intervention, leakage, runtime, competence, and ITT gates pass
GO_PREFERRED.claim_scope: Eligible for preregistered causal/model claims only subject to every other frozen gate.

all_required: At least eight untouched test source groups
All surviving records pass unchanged construct, rights, privacy, and contamination rules
GO_DESCRIPTIVE_FALLBACK.claim_scope: Descriptive narrow source-bounded diagnostic reporting only; insufficient for causal/model-effect claims, controller superiority, population ranking, or broad model/generalization claims.

REPAIR: Preferred 30/12 composition is not yet legally and technically admitted but unchanged reserves remain.
Train/dev yield or profile targets miss and can be prospectively narrowed before test authoring.
A test slot fails before semantic exposure and an untouched predeclared same-split reserve exists.
Reviewer assignment, labor, or packet defects are correctable without exposing test or weakening the construct.
NO_GO: Scale falls below the 60/20/8 floor: 60 H2, 20 source groups, or eight untouched test groups.
A test source or reserve is contaminated and no untouched predeclared replacement remains.
Source, participant, household, continuous-recording, mirror, or production-lineage leakage cannot be resolved.
Rights, privacy, restricted annotation, or deletion obligations cannot be satisfied.
Preferred claims require forced labels, pooled mechanisms, hidden semantic labels, model-guided test mining, or outcome-conditioned replacement.
The budget or schedule can close only by dropping one of the six roles or saturation audit.
current_basis: Preferred counts and pools are now concrete, but no scale-up human work has occurred.
Only 15 nominated development/calibration groups have exact local media; unresolved train/dev/test acquisitions remain.
Assembly101 media access is gated and duration/audio are unresolved.
Independent public/rights-ready lineage count is zero.
No test group has passed the complete acquisition, rights, audio, duration, privacy, and custody gate.
No source in this plan has produced an H2 result.

final_boundary_statement: This artifact freezes a prospective source-disjoint scale-up design. It does not create human review, accepted SESs, H2 families, acquisition or annotation authority, test eligibility by fiat, scientific execution, causal effects, model comparisons, or release authority.
